title: 平安集团Michael Guo：95%新产品为参与型，如何平衡负债成本与资产配置？
speaker: Michael Guo

segments.en: This year, 95% of our new business sales are participating products, which means the cost of a liability. It actually can be low, quite managed depending on how we manage the investment return.
segments.zh: 今年我们95%的新业务销售是参与型产品，这意味着负债成本。实际上它可以很低，相当可控，取决于我们如何管理**回报。

segments.en: So that's one side of the story. The other side of the story is on the investment side, making sure that we actually allocate a good portion on the fixing con, on the alternatives, and reduce the allocation on the public equity.
segments.zh: 所以这是一方面。另一方面是在**端，确保我们实际上在固定收益、另类资产上配置良好比例，并减少公开权益资产的配置。

segments.en: Going forward, what do you think will be and is already shaping up to be the next phase of growth from the demand perspective?
segments.zh: 展望未来，从需求角度看，您认为下一阶段的增长会是什么，并且已经初具雏形？
